Path: approvals and automation — an author can build an inbound flow without code | 缺项 (Studio's start-node inspector writes an unrouted `webhook` token and has no secret field) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the trigger select writes `api`, and the start node gets a write-only secret field

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` (the `start` inspector, `:368` onward) ⇒ `domain:ui`, a published library.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T06:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. ⛔ Keep the PR abstract about the secret, under the security disclosure rule (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20552).

**Why p2.** Choosing 「Webhook / API」 in Studio writes `triggerType: 'webhook'`, a token the engine never routes, so the flow never receives a post and nothing says why. Since objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #20551, an `api` flow also needs a secret that Studio has no field for. So no Studio author can build a working inbound flow. The road is broken for this surface, but the code path remains, so it is runs-but-wrong.

**Direction.**
- **The select writes `api`**, the token `resolveFlowTriggerKind` routes. Before changing the value, census stored flows carrying `triggerType: 'webhook'` (examples and seeds). If any exist, the inspector reads `webhook` as `api` on load and saves `api`. ⛔ No second routing token in the engine.
- **A `config.secret` field on the start node when the kind is `api`**, through the existing `writeOnly` / `secret` widget. It is write-only: the inspector shows whether a secret is set, never its value. A save without a new value keeps the stored secret. This is the round-trip rule objectstack-ai/objectstack#20552 prescribes for the read side.
- A missing secret on an `api` start node is shown at authoring time, with the same meaning as the engine's refusal (rule `flow-api-trigger-secret-missing` once objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #20593 lands).
- **Pins:** an `api` start node saves `triggerType: 'api'` with a secret. A re-save without touching the secret keeps it. A stored `webhook` token loads as `api`.

- Pack keys for any new label in the ten locale packs only if the inspector's existing labels live there (measure first); pins; one `.changeset/11054-…md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`).
- ⛔ No second routing token in the engine; ⛔ the PR stays abstract about the secret (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20552's disclosure rule).
Stop on breach; explain in the report.

Clause-②: no
Why no: an inspector writes the token the engine already routes and offers a field the spec already declares; no objectui type, schema or export moves.
